title: WOOP after-action friction log
summary: After a mission fails, record the exact obstacle and shrink the next if-then plan by one step.
evidence: Established implementation-intention and feedback-loop practice; low risk and easy to test.
experiment: For 7 days, add one friction sentence after any missed TOP 3 mission.

title: Keep reminder payloads generic
summary: Notification text should avoid private goals or sensitive context because it can appear on a lock screen.
evidence: Privacy-preserving default for public-url, local-first PWA use.
experiment: Use generic morning and evening reminder copy until Web Push privacy rules are written.

title: Monthly adoption gate
summary: New methods should enter the operating system only after a review, not immediately after discovery.
evidence: Reduces system thrash and keeps the main behavior loop stable.
experiment: Only mark one method as adoption-ready per monthly review.
